cases.title: Reusable Setting Definition remains distinct from Campaign instance
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-12 taxonomy / world-setting-definition + campaign-instantiation-current-setting-state; PPIA-08 handoff
governed_facts: Reusable source-backed setting identity is distinct from Campaign-local changed, occupied, destroyed, discovered or Scene/session state.
acceptance: Inspecting or editing Campaign state never rewrites the reusable Setting Definition.
Instantiating a setting in a Campaign stores stable Definition references and Campaign provenance.

cases.title: Havalaea to Vertigon hierarchy uses explicit source evidence
cases.source_coordinate: Havalaea.PDF; Vertigon.PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory nested-setting pattern
governed_facts: Havalaea.PDF describes Vertigon at the heart of Havalaea; Vertigon.PDF independently presents Vertigon as a city on Havalaea.
acceptance: Inspector may show a typed Havalaea → Vertigon containment relation with both source coordinates.
The relation is attributable and is not generalized into unsupported neighboring hierarchy.

cases.title: Co-occurrence or name similarity does not create hierarchy
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-12 foundation guardrail 4 / no hierarchy by co-occurrence
fixture_requirements: two setting/location candidates share a document, name fragment, theme, faction or geographic plausibility but lack explicit relation evidence
acceptance: No parent/child, membership, route, chronology or compatibility relation is created automatically.
Inspector displays unresolved relation state rather than a fabricated hierarchy.

cases.title: Black Vegas remains a nonplanetary city-station setting
cases.source_coordinate: Black Vegas.PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory nonplanetary pattern
governed_facts: Black Vegas is explicitly treated as a spaceborne city-station setting in the Chronica Branch.
acceptance: Typed hierarchy can represent city-station identity without requiring a planet parent.
Missing parent or planetary geography remains unknown unless explicitly sourced.

cases.title: Antiquaria generation-ship setting is not forced into planet geography
cases.source_coordinate: The Antiquaria.PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory nonplanetary pattern
governed_facts: The Antiquaria is described as a semi-transdimensional generation-ship setting with built-on cities and the Coalescence.
acceptance: Generation-ship and internal settlement concepts remain typed rather than normalized to planet/continent/country defaults.
Inspector preserves source terminology and unknown relation details.

cases.title: Rakuuta Road connectivity is a route relation, not a world
cases.source_coordinate: The Rakuuta Road.PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory cross-reality infrastructure pattern
governed_facts: The Rakuuta Road describes pathways connecting realities rather than a single world.
acceptance: Inspector projects route endpoints/access/connectivity separately from containment hierarchy.
Shared multiversal context alone does not create additional routes.

cases.title: Cosmology branches layers and planes use typed placement
cases.source_coordinate: The layers of the multiverse.PDF; New Branches Info.PDF; Elemental Planes.PDF
governed_facts: Retained sources describe cosmological layers, branches and planes as setting structures.
acceptance: Placement uses typed branch/plane/layer relations with source coordinates.
Planet-only hierarchy assumptions are rejected.

cases.title: Musical Reality mechanics remain setting-local
cases.source_coordinate: Musical Reality Gameplay.PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory setting-local mechanics pattern
governed_facts: Musical Reality Gameplay.PDF explicitly scopes mechanics to certain musical realities.
acceptance: Local mechanics are displayed with explicit setting scope.
No universal/core rule promotion occurs without separate authority.

cases.title: Branch-specific gameplay rules remain branch-scoped
cases.source_coordinate: New Branches Info.PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory setting-local mechanics pattern
governed_facts: New Branches Info.PDF defines branch-specific gameplay mechanics.
acceptance: Rule extensions retain branch scope and provenance.
Cross-branch use requires explicit governed extension or promotion rather than silent inheritance.

cases.title: Unusual local physics remain scoped to their setting evidence
cases.source_coordinate: The Chaos v2.PDF; The Gray Sands.PDF; Elemental Planes.PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory
governed_facts: These retained setting sources contain unusual local physical or environmental behavior.
acceptance: Inspector separates local-physics/rule-extension fields from universal rules.
Unknown applicability outside the sourced setting remains unknown.

cases.title: Reusable environment template does not instantiate named-world facts
cases.source_coordinate: Ruins and Temples.PDF; Post-apocalyptic Environments.PDF; Space Environments.PDF; Urban Environments.PDF; Industrial Zones 11-13-24.PDF; Jungle and Forests.PDF; Aquatic Environments.PDF; Other Environments.PDF
governed_facts: Eight retained environment PDFs are reusable archetype/template evidence rather than named World Definitions.
acceptance: A template may be inspected or attached through explicit authoring but never proves membership in a named setting by itself.
Template fields and setting-attached environment state remain distinguishable.

cases.title: Worldbuilding guidance and random tables create proposals only
cases.source_coordinate: Worldbuilding.PDF; World Creation tables.PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory authoring-aid boundary
governed_facts: Worldbuilding guidance and random-generation tables are authoring aids, not automatic canonical facts.
acceptance: Generated suggestions carry proposal provenance and do not alter canonical setting Definition until explicit acceptance.
Rejected or abandoned proposals leave source Definitions unchanged.

cases.title: Empire source mixed facets are not flattened to one World record
cases.source_coordinate: The Empire.PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory mixed-facet pattern
governed_facts: The Empire.PDF combines governance, economy, law, regional oversight, organizations and regulation examples.
acceptance: Inspector routes governance, institutions, economy, regional scope and other facets to distinct semantic groups.
Document membership alone does not imply that every facet is a World identity field.

cases.title: Noir City districts landmarks factions remain distinct facets
cases.source_coordinate: Noir City(1).PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory mixed-facet pattern
governed_facts: Noir City(1).PDF combines districts, landmarks, factions and local setting details.
acceptance: District hierarchy, landmark identity and faction presence remain separately typed.
Faction co-occurrence does not create location parentage or ownership without evidence.

cases.title: Stratebrait revision conflicts remain explicit
cases.source_coordinate: Stratebrait.PDF; PPIA-12 source inventory revision/conflict pattern
governed_facts: Stratebrait.PDF contains older/current/new material and requests reconciliation.
acceptance: Inspector preserves conflicting/revision assertions with source coordinates.
A resolution candidate remains a governed proposal until accepted and never mutates raw source.

cases.title: World-local object extension preserves owning domain definition
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-12_SETTING_EXTENSION_ROUTING_v0.1.0.json; PPIA-02/03/04/05 ownership boundaries
fixture_requirements: a setting source references a Species, Creature, Item, Vehicle or Ability with local availability, membership, variant or rule metadata
acceptance: PPIA-12 stores setting scope/extension metadata while core object Definition remains in its owning domain.
Local extension does not silently fork, overwrite or universalize the owning object mechanics.

cases.title: Campaign destruction occupation or discovery does not rewrite source setting
cases.source_coordinate: PPIA-12 campaign-instantiation-current-setting-state + PPIA-08 handoff
fixture_requirements: Campaign instance references a reusable location that becomes destroyed, occupied, renamed locally or newly discovered
acceptance: Campaign-local mutation updates only Campaign/Scene state with expected-version/idempotency controls.
Reusable source Definition and other Campaigns remain unchanged.

cases.title: Hidden locations routes and history do not leak through aggregates or pathfinding
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F020/F021 + PPIA-12 knowledge-visibility-secret-state
fixture_requirements: viewer may inspect a setting but lacks permission for one hidden location, secret route and unrevealed historical fact
acceptance: Counts, search facets, hierarchy nodes, map labels, pathfinding, summaries, warnings, exports, diagnostics, notifications and AI context are computed after filtering.
Failed navigation or action validation does not reveal hidden fact existence.

cases.title: Ambiguous authoring mutation resolves by operation-status lookup
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F021 + PPIA-12 provenance-conflict-recovery
fixture_requirements: client loses response after an idempotent hierarchy, environment attachment, route, reveal or Campaign-handoff write that may already have committed
acceptance: Client queries operation ID/status before retry.
Retry reuses idempotency identity and cannot duplicate relations, attachments, reveals, history entries or Campaign instantiation.

cases.title: Accessible nonvisual hierarchy route and setting authoring
cases.source_coordinate: MV-IA-F022 + PPIA-12 accessibility invariants
fixture_requirements: keyboard-only and screen-reader user inspects hierarchy, evaluates route connectivity, reads environment/local rules, authors a typed relation and completes recovery
acceptance: No required step depends on color, drag, hover, animation, map geometry or visual node placement.
Hierarchy levels, relation types, endpoints, reveal state, source/conflict status, validation and authoritative result are available as semantic text.
